My new channel for Cat Vlog: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcm5BscpsXkuvRsQF1J9ZOA
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ohnino2/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Ninos-Home-105401167869371/
●● Recipe (レシピ):
- Corn
- Cabbage
- Carrot
- Green onion
- 300g Lean pork
- 1Tsp Salt
- 1Tsp Sugar
- 1/4Tsp Ground pepper
- 100g Chicken powder
- 50g Salt
- 20g Sugar
- 5g Chili powder
- 5g Ground pepper
- 20g Shallot
- 20g Garlic
- 100g Vegetable oil
- 500g Bread flour
- 130g Water
- 5g Salt
1 Egg
#ASMR #OhNino #NinosHome #noodles #Mukbang
I learned most of these recipes online and tweaked the measurements to suit my own taste. You can absolutely follow my recipes and adjust them to your liking too. I’m definitely not the first person to make them. I hope my videos can help you successfully make the dishes you love.
And finally, I’m just a home cook, not a professional chef. Thank you so much!
